description:
Capability sets were not displayed in the [Demand|Confirm]Active PDUs, this patch
fixes that. It also adds a missing capality set type (frame acknowledge).
And finally it contains code refactoring to display each kind of capability set, as
an example the RAIL capabilities set are fully implemented.

commits_data.message:
rdp: fix parsing of capability sets

Capability sets were not displayed in the [Demand|Confirm]Active PDUs, this patch
fixes that. It also adds a missing capality set type (frame acknowledge).
And finally it contains code refactoring to display each kind of capability set, as
an example the RAIL capabilities set are fully implemented.
